en:
Hmm, so this is Himiko's research lab.
What were we gonna investigate, again?

The trick that Himiko used in her magic show.
...I need to figure out how it worked.

Well, you say that, but what if it was
real <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic<CLT=cltNORMAL>, with no tricks or mechanisms?
...Well, that would be a problem.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it's not just about
the trick...
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to ask that guy some questions.

Even if it's to solve this case,
revealing Himiko's tricks is...
Well, it makes things...kinda boring.

Huh? Kaito, are you the type who wants 
to believe in magic?
Ooh! Kaito believes in Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
That's not what I mean.

I was just thinking that her tricks are
like <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic<CLT=cltNORMAL> that brings smiles to people.

Ah, yeah. I guess you could think about it 
that way...
Besides, it's just like my dream to go to space!

I believe I can travel across the Milky Way!
I believe I will meet aliens!

Flying around space with thoughts like that
is the true spirit of adventure!
Aah, so it's like that...
Kaito, that's...

...the stupidest thing I've ever heard! Your
idealistic dreams won't help this situation!
Hey! Who you callin' stupid!?
Ah, n-no need to yell...

I know it's not actually <CLT=cltSTRONG>magic<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Anyway, let's just start the investigation!

Hey, Shuichi.
Did you wanna ask me something?

I'll tell you aaaanything you wanna know.
You are my favorite, after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>When he says that, it sounds like he means
the opposite. It makes me nervous...

I do, actually. It's about when we
were kidnapped by Gonta yesterday.

You snuck into our rooms to
steal our <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive videos<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

But is that *all* you were doing?
You came back pretty late.

I see... You wanna know my alibi for nightime
yesterday. That's a good question to ask.

The gym is off-limits during nighttime, so Ryoma
was probably killed before or after...

Which makes nighttime yesterday so suspicious,
since everyone was doing their own thing.
And what were you doing then?

It'd be easier if I just explained, step by step,
what happened while I was out last night.

After you regained consciousness, Shuichi,
Gonta brought Himiko and Angie...
That was about five minutes before 9 p.m.

Right after that, I left Gonta's lab
and headed toward the dorms.

I thought I'd be back in an hour—the start of
nighttime—but something happened...
Something happened?

Right when I got to the entrance hall,
Kirumi spotted me.

That was right after I left Gonta's lab...
so it was right around 9 p.m.

She started throwing questions at me left
and right, asking if I was up to no good.

Then she started criticizing my behavior, and
lecturing me on my manners and relationships...

Can you believe that? I mean, who does she
think she is—my mom or something!?

Didn't you ask Kirumi to
"be your mom" earlier?

She just kept talking...then finally let me go
at 10:00 p.m., when nighttime rolled around.
...A whole hour?

Well, only the first half hour was a lecture,
then we played tag for the other half.

She was starting to bore me so I turned
around to leave, and then...

Stop right there... Our conversation is not
over yet.

I don't gotta listen to you! You're not worthy of
lecturing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
C'mon, Miss Maid! Catch me if you can!
Is that...a request?

And then...I guess Kirumi decided to take
tag super seriously...

I tried my best, but in the end, she caught
me a little before 10 p.m.

Then she started lecturing me again, and
let me go when nighttime started.

So do your alibis still hold up, even when
she was chasing you around?

We ran into each other a bunch of times,
so yeah, they should hold up.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then from 9:00 p.m. until nighttime,
both Kokichi and Kirumi have alibis.

After Kirumi let me go, I finally went to the
dorms and collected everyone's videos.

But by the time I returned to Gonta's lab,
it was already 11 p.m.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then from ten to eleven,
he doesn't have an alibi!

Oh yeah... I did see something odd while
Kirumi was lecturing me.
...Something odd?

I saw a half-naked girl, wandering around
the courtyard in her underwear.

It was too dark for me to make out who it
was, but I saw her walk around for a bit.
I wonder who it was...

<CLT=cltMIND>A girl in her underwear?
What the hell is he talking about?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's Account<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

By the way...you didn't get captured by Gonta
yesterday, did you Kaito?
Where were you? And what were you doing?

I was running around the whole time. I hid in 
bathrooms, bedrooms, all over the school...
Hmmm, I see.

Hm? You wanna hear my alibi for nighttime
yesterday again?

For you, Shuichi, I'll tell you as many times
as you want! You're my favorite, after all!

It'd be easier if I just explained, step by step,
what happened while I was out last night.

After you regained consciousness, Shuichi,
Gonta brought Himiko and Angie...
That was about five minutes before 9 p.m.

Right after that, I left Gonta's lab
and headed toward the dorms.

I thought I'd be back in an hour—the start of
nighttime—but something happened...

Right when I got to the entrance hall,
Kirumi spotted me.

That was right after I left Gonta's lab...
so it was right around 9 p.m.

She started throwing questions at me left
and right, asking if I was up to no good.

She just kept talking...then finally let me go
at 10:00 p.m., when nighttime rolled around.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then from 9:00 p.m. until nighttime,
both Kokichi and Kirumi have alibis.

I finally went to the dorms and collected
everyone's videos.

But by the time I returned to Gonta's lab,
it was already 11 p.m.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then from ten to eleven...
he has no alibi.

Oh yeah... I did see something odd while
Kirumi was lecturing me.

I saw a half-naked girl, wandering around
the courtyard in her underwear.

It was too dark for me to make out who it
was, but I saw her walk around for a bit.
I wonder who it was...
What are you doing here, Tsumugi?

Huh? Well, I'm investigating. I know I'm plain,
but it's plain to see I'm investigating.
Ah...is that so?
So? Did you find any clues?
I'm...still thinking about that.

I don't think...you can uncover clues
just by thinking about them...

Umm, no... In fact, I still haven't 
found anything.

Then get to it!
Looking around is how you find clues!

But, I think leaving that guy alone 
is just plain bad...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi gave Kokichi a
meaningful glance.

So, I've decided to plainly keep an eye 
on him.
That way, even plain old me can help out.

I think leaving that guy alone 
is just plain bad.
So I'm going to plainly keep an eye on him.

It doesn't really matter, but not saying his 
name makes him sound like an evil wizard.

<CLT=cltMIND>I think there are still things
to investigate here...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a huge water tank. It looks like the
one that was used in Himiko's show...

It looks like the same tank Himiko used in 
the show. I guess this one was a backup.

That's what Himiko told me and Keebo 
when we carried the tank out of here...

Then perhaps if we investigate *this* tank,
we can learn the secret of the trick...

<CLT=cltMIND>Encouraged, I began walking
around the tank.

<CLT=cltMIND>I was looking for anything that
could be a switch or mechanism...
Hm? What's this?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a segment of the tank near the top
that opens up. But why open up there?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, wait.
Perhaps it isn't random...

<CLT=cltMIND>This segment...*had*
to open up here.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Water Tank Trick<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>What a huge saw...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably used for the
saw-a-person-in-half trick.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this used for magic tricks too?
I've seen it in magic shows before...
<CLT=cltMIND>This has...nothing to do with the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are several swords stabbed into
a human-sized box.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if there was a person inside, they
would come out just fine. That's the trick, I think.
<CLT=cltMIND>This has...nothing to do with the case.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a big cage...
I might fit inside this...
